method: Each provided fact was re-read against the live source page on the check date. Facts without an official page were searched for; anything we couldn't find stays Uncertain.

checked.claim: No approval needed; form asks for name, homepage URL, optional description, callback URL
GitHub recommends GitHub Apps (fine-grained permissions, short-lived tokens)
Max 100 OAuth apps per user or org
Marketplace review is manual and can't be accelerated
Public distribution must be enabled before Marketplace submission
gmail.readonly and gmail.modify are restricted; gmail.send is sensitive
Restricted scopes need an annual security assessment (CASA)
100-user cap before verification; Internal apps skip verification
Community Management only for registered legal orgs with commercial use cases
Development tier first, then separate Standard tier with screen recording and privacy policy
LinkedIn may reject even if minimum requirements are met
Composio managed auth exists for GitHub, Slack, Gmail, LinkedIn
Public connections use OAuth 2.0; PATs and internal connections use static tokens
Installation scope (Any workspace / Selected workspaces only) can't be changed after creation
Marketplace listing is optional; replies within 5–10 business days
Composio has a managed OAuth app for Notion

corrected.original: OAuth apps support only one callback URL.
corrected.corrected: GitHub's docs now say you can enter up to 10 callback URLs.

corrected.original: Form asks for name, homepage, description, callback URL.
corrected.corrected: The form also has 'Enable Device Flow' and 'Expire user access tokens' (on by default).

corrected.original: Incomplete submissions are returned and lose queue position.
corrected.corrected: Refined: resubmitting during preliminary review resets your place. Once a functional reviewer is assigned, resubmitting doesn't.
Added hard prerequisites: at least 10 workspaces active in the past 28 days, and Slack's published windows of up to 10 business days (preliminary) plus up to 10 weeks (functional).

corrected.original: Most Gmail scopes (including gmail.readonly, gmail.modify) are restricted.
corrected.corrected: Made exact: gmail.compose, gmail.metadata, gmail.insert, and gmail.settings.* are also restricted; gmail.labels is non-sensitive.

corrected.original: Up to 100 test users before verification.
corrected.corrected: Added that the cap is lifetime and can't be reset, and Testing-mode tokens expire after 7 days (third-party source).

corrected.original: gmail.send is a restricted scope that needs a CASA assessment.
corrected.corrected: gmail.send is sensitive, not restricted: it needs verification (justification and demo video) but no CASA.

corrected.original: Community Management can be added alongside other products on an existing app.
corrected.corrected: Community Management must be the only product on its developer app; otherwise the request button is greyed out. Create a dedicated app. (This rule is on the Partner Support Guide, not the app-review page.)

corrected.original: Slack Marketplace review takes about 4 months.
corrected.corrected: Slack publishes up to 10 business days (preliminary) plus up to 10 weeks (functional). Review can be slow, but the 4-month figure is one anecdotal report and is labeled Uncertain.

uncertain.claim: A Marketplace review took about 4 months
uncertain.why: A single developer anecdote. Slack publishes up to ~10 weeks for functional review.
Vendor pricing from a third party (Nango, Aug 2025). Google doesn't publish prices.

uncertain.claim: Review durations (under a week sensitive; 4–6 weeks restricted)
uncertain.why: From third-party docs. Google publishes no SLA.
LinkedIn publishes no SLA for this product.

uncertain.claim: Developer app creation form fields (logo, privacy URL)
uncertain.why: The form requires login. We didn't create accounts, so we didn't observe it.

uncertain.claim: w_member_social via 'Share on LinkedIn' is self-serve
uncertain.why: Not checked against an official page this round.

uncertain.claim: Whether Composio's managed apps are suitable for production branding
uncertain.why: The managed-auth page doesn't address it.

uncertain.claim: Whether a public connection needs review before its Authorization URL works
uncertain.why: The docs say the field populates after the connection is submitted for review, but give no timing or approval criteria. Not tested.

uncertain.claim: Privacy policy, demo video, business entity requirements
uncertain.why: Not mentioned in the three Notion pages we checked.
Our estimates; Notion publishes no times.
